race.comment: PACIFICO (10) hgas shown plenty at the trials coming into this, winning her latest heat at Rosehill by a nose. That sort of trial form stacks right up for a country maiden and plenty of scratchings has opened the door right up for her. Can make an immediate impact. ROMANCASTLE (3) has some race expereience under her belt when not far away before the break over 1200m at Kembla. Fitter for two trials coming in and resuming over 1100m seems a big tick. Can return on a positive note. LOW DOWN (9) hasn't been far away in her past couple of trials and looks well placed here on debut. Hails from a handy family and can make an impression. MAYWEATHER (1) drew wide last start and never got into the race. A better draw and 1100m today is a bonus. Can bounce back to his best.
